title: Kindergarten Grammars: Designing with Froebel’s Building Gifts
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: Froebel’s building blocks become a setting for constructing whole languages of designs. Stiny shifts attention from producing one composition to stating rules that make its possibilities understandable and reusable.
prerequisites: Elementary sets and functions; some proof reading

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

verification.scope: Scanned primary paper: opening discussion; five-stage programme; selected spatial-relation and grammar examples; conclusions on pp. 459–461. Selected pages of the 54-page paper were read with OCR and scan inspection. This is a framework and illustrated argument, not a measured comparison of children’s learning.
